content.short: Turkish crypto exchange and issuer of TRYB, a stablecoin pegged to the Turkish lira.
content.description: BiLira runs two businesses for Turkish users. BiLira Kripto is a trading platform with lira pairs, low fees and a rewards centre that adds perks the more you trade. TRYB is its lira-pegged stablecoin, which lets people and apps hold and move Turkish lira value on-chain. Plasma is among the networks where TRYB is available.
content.meta: Buy and sell crypto in Turkish lira on BiLira Kripto, or hold TRYB, BiLira's lira-backed stablecoin, on-chain.
